newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 14.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.

- Presidium of the Fifth Session of the Eighth National People's Congress decided at its third meeting on Thursday to put several draft laws and resolutions to a vote at the last plenum of the session due today.
- The United States should play a positive role in Hong Kong's smooth transition and long-term prosperity and stability, says Foreign Ministry spokesman Cui Tiankai

- China's accession to the World Trade Organization has made some major progress recently, but there are still many obstacles that remain to be overcome, says statement from Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation Thursday.
- Deputies to National People's Congress say they pin high hopes on upcoming 15th Congress of Communist Party of China to be held in the second half of this year.
- Louis Gerstner Jr., chairman of IBM, tells President Jiang Zemin his company will play aa greater role in China's modernisation drive.
- Central bank survey finds 30.6 percent of urban residents think current prices are unacceptably high
- China Construction Bank loans 800 billion yuan to Sichuan Changhong in 1996
- Guangdong provincial governor Lu Ruihua says expects economic growth of 10 percent in 1997
- Ministry of Machine Building official says China not to reverse plan to build pillar industry out of automobile sector
